name: knowledge_agent_compile_ok
description: Agent with knowledge store, proper recall dispatch, and learn compiles cleanly
input:
use
  llm.reason

agent learner
  memory
    count: Number
  knowledge store: ".forge-knowledge/test"
    max_entries: 1000

  on query(q: Text)
    prior = recall "{q}"
    when prior.sure -> give prior
    else -> escalate to human

  on train(fact: Text)
    learn "{fact}"
    say "Learned"
